result.description: A fictional server memory kit designed for high-reliability workstation and datacenter use, featuring DDR5 ECC Registered modules with a total capacity of 48GB. Built for stable operation in multi-socket environments, it emphasizes low-latency error correction, thermal management, and platform compatibility with modern enterprise boards. Includes a brushed-silver heat spreader and support for standard JEDEC profiles.
result.title: Aurelia Driftfield 48GB DDR5 ECC Memory Kit
